using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.Cluster
{
    public class ClusterManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryPrepareSlotsForMigration_LogsTrace_WhenCalledSuccessfully()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterManager = new ClusterManagerForTest(loggerMock.Object);

            var slots = new HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            string nodeId = "node1";

            // Setup the currentConfig to simulate a valid state for migration
            clusterManager.SetupCurrentConfigForMigration(nodeId);

            // Act
            var result = clusterManager.TryPrepareSlotsForMigration(slots, nodeId, out var errorMessage);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            Assert.True(errorMessage.IsEmpty);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Processed] SetSlot")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper subclass to allow injecting logger and controlling currentConfig
        private class ClusterManagerForTest : ClusterManager
        {
            private ILogger _logger;
            public ClusterManagerForTest(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                base.logger = logger;
            }

            public void SetupCurrentConfigForMigration(string nodeId)
            {
                // Setup a fake currentConfig that returns expected values for migration
                var fakeConfig = new FakeClusterConfig(nodeId);
                base.currentConfig = fakeConfig;
            }
        }

        // Fake cluster config to simulate expected behavior for migration
        private class FakeClusterConfig : IClusterConfig
        {
            private readonly string _nodeId;

            public FakeClusterConfig(string nodeId)
            {
                _nodeId = nodeId;
            }

            public int GetWorkerIdFromNodeId(string nodeid)
            {
                return nodeid == _nodeId ? 1 : 0;
            }

            public string LocalNodeId => _nodeId;

            public bool Equals(string other, StringComparison comparison)
            {
                return string.Equals(_nodeId, other, comparison);
            }

            public int LocalNodeConfigEpoch => 1;

            public string LocalNodeIp => "127.0.0.1";

            public int LocalNodePort => 1234;

            public string LocalNodeIdShort => _nodeId.Substring(0, Math.Min(8, _nodeId.Length));

            public IClusterConfig UpdateMultiSlotState(HashSet<int> slots, int workerId, SlotState state)
            {
                return this;
            }

            public IClusterConfig BumpLocalNodeConfigEpoch()
            {
                return this;
            }
        }

        // Dummy interface and enum to satisfy references
        private interface IClusterConfig
        {
            int GetWorkerIdFromNodeId(string nodeid);
            string LocalNodeId { get; }
            int LocalNodeConfigEpoch { get; }
            string LocalNodeIp { get; }
            int LocalNodePort { get; }
            string LocalNodeIdShort { get; }
            IClusterConfig UpdateMultiSlotState(HashSet<int> slots, int workerId, SlotState state);
            IClusterConfig BumpLocalNodeConfigEpoch();
        }

        private enum SlotState
        {
            STABLE,
            MIGRATING,
            OFFLINE
        }
    }
}

The ClusterManager class is internal sealed, so I cannot subclass it directly for testing. Also, the logger field is readonly and set only in the constructor, so I cannot inject a mock logger easily.

I will try to use the parameterize_dependency refactor to add a constructor overload that takes a logger, so I can inject a mock logger for testing. This will allow me to test the TryPrepareSlotsForMigration method and verify the LogTrace call.

        // Helper method to create ClusterManager instance with reflection to set logger

        }

                return this;
            }
